RE-ENCODE
Stream 1: HEVC/H.265
The first video stream is decoded and encoded as MPEG-2 at 4 Mbps, source dimensions and constant source timing, with automatic quantizer policy. Native checks refuse VFR, full-range input or changing dimensions; 8-bit pixel-format conversion can be lossy. Non-default controls remain qualification-only until their browser gates pass.
